verdict.rationale: Codegen's docs say the agent can write tests and can run code and test changes in isolated sandbox environments, which covers generating and executing tests. The docs do not describe an automatic loop where the agent validates its own changes with those tests before opening a PR. missing for 10: documented automatic test-run gating before PR creation, details of the self-validation/iteration loop on test failures, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them

citations.quote: Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Safely run code, install dependencies, and test changes in robust isolated environments
Agents can create new pull requests with code changes
